available.title: Available
available.description: Whether the log database could be read. False means the figures are unknown, which is not the same as "nothing has happened" - callers should show them as unknown rather than as zero.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: Unique identifier (GUID) of the project the workflow belongs to.

last_activity.title: Last Activity
last_activity.description: ISO-8601 UTC time of the workflow's most recent archived record; null if it has none.

errors.title: Errors
errors.description: ERROR-level records archived across the workflow since it was last acknowledged (all-time if never acknowledged).

last_activity.title: Last Activity
last_activity.description: ISO-8601 UTC time of the node's most recent archived record; null if it has none.

errors.title: Errors
errors.description: ERROR-level records archived for the node since it was last acknowledged (all-time if never acknowledged).

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.description: The same two figures per node. Workflow-scoped records belong to no node and are counted only in the workflow totals.

workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.description: One entry per workflow that has archived at least one record. Workflows absent from the list have none.
